## Summary

Checks a data module against a BREX and returns each violation with its location (XPath and line number), actual value, rule ID, description and severity level. By default it follows the `brexDmRef` chain and checks against each layer separately

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> Check a data module against BREX rules and report violations with location (XPath + line), actual value, rule id, objectUse text and severity. Also accepts a publication module (pm) or a comment (the brexDmRef in pmStatus / commentStatus is followed). By default follows the document's brexDmRef chain (project BREX → … → S1000D default BREX found under S1000D_SPEC_DIR) and checks each layer separately; pass "brex" to check against one specific BREX instead or in addition. Does NOT validate against the XML schema (XSD): run schema validation separately. nonContextRules cannot be checked automatically and are returned as manualChecks.

## Arguments

The content of `inputSchema`. A nested argument is written as `parent.child`, and an item of an array as `parent[].child`.

| Name | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` |  |  | File path of the data module to check. |
| `xml` | `string` |  |  | The data module as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). |
| `brex` | `string` |  |  | A specific BREX (file path or DMC) to check against. With followChain=false it is the only layer; otherwise it is added to the chain. |
| `followChain` | `boolean` |  | default `true` | Follow the brexDmRef chain of the data module (default true). |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders to search for BREX by DMC (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; S1000D_SPEC_DIR is always searched for the S1000D default BREX). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `includeManualChecks` | `boolean` |  | default `true` | Include nonContextRules as manualChecks in each layer (default true). |
| `maxViolationsPerLayer` | `number` |  | default `200` | Cap on violations returned per layer (default 200). The total count is always reported. |
